mainEntity.name: What should I automate first if I have a launch next week and multiple projects competing for attention?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the deadline is urgent, automate preparation rather than final execution. Use AI to organize research, draft copy, summarize project status, or create checklists, then reserve time for fact-checking, brand review, link testing, and approval. Avoid connecting new accounts or launching an untested multi-step workflow immediately before a campaign or product release. Key factors are the cost of an error, the number of platforms, the availability of a fallback manual process, and who can approve work quickly. Run My AI Biz’s launch examples include review before anything goes live, which is especially important under time pressure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Automate preparation, not final execution: research summaries, outlines, checklists, draft copy, and status reports. Keep fact checks, link tests, account changes, spending, and publication manual. Use a fallback process and do not introduce untested integrations immediately before launch.
